sentence: Build me a website in two or more languages.
title: Build a multilingual website with your agent
description: A prompt for your agent to build a website in two or more languages with Astro or Next and i18next, and what to do when your client wants to change the texts later.
quote: I need a website for my bakery in English and German, and I want my agent to build it.
whoHas: For the owner who builds their own site, a bakery or a practice, and for the one-person agency that builds a site for each client with an agent and looks after it afterwards.
hint: Replace the parts in brackets, then paste it into your agent

sentence: Add a second language to my site or app.
title: Add a second language to your site or app
description: The texts are written into the code today: the prompt that has your agent move them into translation files with i18next-cli, add a language and check that every language is complete.
quote: All our texts are written into the code. Add German.
whoHas: For whoever has a working site or app in one language, with the texts inside the components, and wants a second language without going through every file by hand.
hint: Replace the part in brackets, then paste it into your agent

sentence: Let my client change the texts without a developer.
title: Let your client change the texts without you
description: Two ways for people who do not code to change a site's texts: the translation files themselves, with a check in the build, or an editor such as Locize.
crumb: Texts for people who do not code
quote: My client wants to change the wording on the site without waiting for me.
whoHas: For the agency or freelancer who built a site and looks after it, and for the team where the people who write are not the people who code.
hint: Replace the parts in brackets, then paste it into your agent

sentence: Keep the other languages current when the English changes.
title: Keep every language current when the English changes
description: New texts reach every language through i18next-cli extract and status; changed texts under the same key need a step of their own. The prompt for both.
quote: We changed the pricing page in English last month. The German page still says the old thing.
whoHas: For teams that keep changing the main language and ship in others: product teams, sites with many pages, anyone whose translations come a step behind.
hint: Replace the parts in brackets, then paste it into your agent

title: Make each language version findable
description: One address per language, html lang, hreflang links and a sitemap with every language version: the prompt, and where it goes in Astro and Next.
quote: The German pages exist, but searches in Germany show the English ones.
whoHas: For sites that already speak more than one language and want search engines and agents to reach the right version of each page.
hint: Replace the part in brackets, then paste it into your agent
